items.title: ESC 2026: Tirzepatide 5mg sustains cardiometabolic benefit with weight maintenance
items.summary: KOLs interviewed by GlobalData consistently recognized tirzepatide's cardiometabolic value as extending well beyond weight loss alone.

items.title: Trump lines up MFN deals with nine mid-size pharmas on drug pricing push

items.title: PharmaEssentia’s Besremi receives FDA approval for ET
items.summary: The US FDA has approved PharmaEssentia’s Besremi (ropeginterferon alfa-2b-njft) to treat adults with essential thrombocythaemia (ET).
